'''Meerko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kreegan Ramar]], who was terrorizing the [[Meerko Clan]].
